notes: Tracker requests automatically switch to a backup Bungie connection if the main one stops working. Tracker search now gives clearer reasons when the service is unavailable, authentication fails, the internet connection has a problem, or a name cannot be found. Tracker filters are cleaner, better organized and easier to read. The overlay module bar removes unused timer space and expands only while a timer is visible. This update includes a backend change. If something does not work after updating, that change is the cause.
